messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH error rate (502/504) observed in gateway-prod starting ~02:05 UTC (30m). 3.1% error rate over last 5m, latency p95 > 2.2s. Paging oncall SRE: @sre-rotation :ambulance: https://ops.redwood/alerts/1947621123
Alex Kim: acked, oncall here. grabbing dashboards / logs :eyes:
Maria Chen: I'm seeing a sharp spike in upstream 502s from service `model-encoder` and a corresponding rise in gateway timeouts. 502s concentrated in /v1/generate endpoint.
Sam Patel: query: `count by(status) from requests where service=gateway-prod and path ~ "/v1/generate" since -30m` -> 502s spiked at 02:04 UTC to ~340/s. normal <5/s.
Lee Johnson: trying to pull traces for a few failed request_ids — can't find traces for most of the 502s. trace sampling looks like it's at 0.01 in prod (super low). that explains poor visibility.
Alex Kim: confirmed customer impact: hosted API calls to text-gen are returning 502 for some customers (no data loss, requests failing). volume is ~3% of overall requests but concentrated on high-token requests -> bigger impact to customers using long contexts.
Maria Chen: possible causes: upstream model OOMs, backend queue exhaustion, or a slow shard causing timeouts and upstream resets. We need quick stopgap telemetry so we can tie gateway 502s to backend errors.
Sam Patel: on the ground steps I'm doing: (1) increase trace sampling to 0.2 for 10m to capture traces, (2) add a temporary structured log from gateway to include request_id, upstream_status, upstream_latency_ms.
Lee Johnson: +1. Also propose increasing gateway timeout to 12s instead of 6s to prevent premature 502s and reduce client retries while we diagnose.
Alex Kim: action plan:
- Sam: enable sampling + create temporary sampling override (10m).
- Maria & Lee: deploy temporary gateway log patch to include upstream metadata.
- Me: route a small percentage (10%) of traffic to `gateway-canary` to see if behavior differs.
- If things improve, we can roll routing back.
Sam Patel: running sampling patch now: `curl -X POST https://tracing-control.prod/api/sampling -d '{"service":"gateway-prod","sample_rate":0.2,"ttl":"10m"}'`
Sam Patel: response: 200 OK -> sampling updated. will monitor for new traces.
Maria Chen: gateway log patch (temp):
```
# add structured log field in gateway request handler
log.Infof("req=%s method=%s path=%s upstream=%s up_status=%d up_lat_ms=%d", req.ID, req.Method, req.Path, upstream.Name, resp.StatusCode, resp.LatencyMs)
```
Applying as env flag so it's easy to revert: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/gateway TEMP_LOG_UPSTREAM=1`
Lee Johnson: applying env flag now -> `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/gateway`
deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/gateway in prod (revision 5123). Estimated completion ~60s.
Alex Kim: while patch rolls, I'm increasing gateway timeout: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/gateway GATEWAY_TIMEOUT=12s` then restart.
deploy-bot: env updated for deployment/gateway (GATEWAY_TIMEOUT=12s), restart queued.
Sam Patel: getting traces now for failed requests — seeing consistent pattern: upstream `model-encoder` returning 500 for long sequences right before gateway 502s. traces show encoder hitting serialization stall then OOM on GPUs around the same timestamps.
Maria Chen: good signal. but we still need correlation in logs for request_id -> upstream error. the temp structured logs should give us that mapping in case traces miss some requests.
Lee Johnson: mitigation options: (A) reduce max tokens per request at gateway for hosted tier (fast), (B) throttle or queue long requests to dedicated pool, (C) fall back to smaller model variant for long contexts. Prefer A+B as immediate stopgap.
Alex Kim: spin up a config change to reject >8k tokens with a 429 for now. Maria, can you prepare a patch? We'll announce as degraded feature.
Maria Chen: yes - preparing a safe config with a 1% gradual rollout and a notice in status page. patch: `kubectl apply -f configs/gateway/limit-long-requests.yaml` -> will roll at 1% per minute.
Sam Patel: logs from gateway show new structured lines correlating request_id -> upstream_status. example log: `req=abc123 method=POST path=/v1/generate upstream=model-encoder up_status=500 up_lat_ms=2310`
Alex Kim: good. Early results after sampling + logs + timeout bump: 502 rate dropped from 3.1% -> 0.9% in 10m. latency p95 back down to ~1.4s.
Lee Johnson: please monitor for client retries causing spikes after timeouts, but this looks promising.
Alex Kim: customer impact update: partial degradation for a subset of long-context hosted API customers. mitigation in place (timeout bump + token limit). No data loss, requests will receive 429 for too-long payloads until full RCA and fix.
Maria Chen: immediate follow-ups (tickets):
- T1: RCA for model-encoder OOMs and resource isolation (assign to eng-ml)
- T2: permanent tracing sampling policy and alert to catch missing traces (assign to observability)
- T3: add persistent structured upstream logs + request_id propagation across services (assign to eng-platform)
Sam Patel: created ticket RED-INC-3145 for RCA and linked traces/logs.
Alex Kim: handing off to next oncall in 20m for monitoring and post-incident follow-ups. @sre-rotation take it from here. I'll update status page and draft the incident summary.
sre-rotation: acked, taking over monitoring. will watch the next 1h and escalate if >1% 502s recurrence.
deploy-bot: gateway rollout (rev 5123) completed.
Maria Chen: leaving a temp config note: TEMP_LOG_UPSTREAM=1, remember to revert after 2h.
Alex Kim: thanks all. we have enough telemetry now to do an informed RCA. closing active paging for now; please add any findings to RED-INC-3145. :white_check_mark:
